# PixelToPath

> Free PNG/JPG/BMP/WebP to SVG converter — online in the browser and as a desktop app for Windows and Linux. Powered by VTracer. Open source.

PixelToPath turns raster images into high-quality SVG vector graphics. Use it free online (no account), or download the desktop app for offline, unlimited conversions. Built for designers and developers who need clean, editable SVG paths from photos, logos, posters, and line art.

Supported formats: PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP. Modes: color (multi-layer vectorization) and black & white. Presets: B&W, Poster, Photo. Advanced controls include curve fitting, filter speckle, corner threshold, and more. Live SVG preview updates as parameters change.

Website: https://pixel-to-path.com
GitHub: https://github.com/lorrisc/PixelToPath
Releases: https://github.com/lorrisc/PixelToPath/releases
Author: Lorris C. (Lorrisc)

- [PNG to SVG Converter - Free, No Signup, No Watermark](https://pixel-to-path.com/online/): Vectorize PNG, JPG, BMP or WebP to SVG online - free, instant, no registration. Powered by VTracer with color and black-and-white modes. Live preview.
- [Offline PNG to SVG Converter - Free Desktop App (Windows & Linux)](https://pixel-to-path.com/offline/): Download PixelToPath, the best free offline software to convert PNG, JPG, BMP and WebP images to SVG vectors. Unlimited conversions, privacy-focused. Windows & Linux.

VAT](https://pixel-to-path.com/pro/): Upgrade to PixelToPath Pro: hot folder monitoring that converts images to SVG automatically, batch conversion of hundreds of images at once, and a full command-line interface. One-time payment, lifetime license for 1 user on up to 3 machines. €39 excl. VAT.
- [Pricing – Free Online Converter, Pro Desktop App & API](https://pixel-to-path.com/pricing/): All PixelToPath versions and prices in one place: free online converter, free open-source desktop app, Pro desktop app at €39 one-time, and the developer API with 10 free conversions per month.
- [PixelToPath API – Image to SVG REST API, 10 Free Conversions/Month](https://pixel-to-path.com/api/): Convert PNG, JPG, BMP or WebP to clean SVG with one REST call. Potrace for black & white line art, VTracer for color vectors. 10 free conversions every month, prepaid images from €0.05 (down to €0.01/image at volume), credits never expire.
- [SVG Conversion Guides & Tips – PixelToPath Blog](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/): Free guides on converting PNG, JPG, and other images to SVG. Learn vectorization, best practices, and how to get the most out of PixelToPath.

## Guides

- [JPG to SVG Converter – Free Online Vector Tool](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/jpg-to-svg/): Turn any JPG or JPEG image into a scalable SVG vector file for free. No account needed, instant results, high-quality output every time.
- [Image to SVG Converter (Free, Fast & Online)](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/image-to-svg/): Convert any image to SVG format for free. Upload PNG, JPG, BMP, or WebP and download a clean vector file instantly. No software needed.
- [Vectorize Image Free – Raster to Vector Online](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/vectorize-image/): Vectorize any image for free online. Convert raster PNG, JPG, BMP, or WebP files to clean SVG vectors. Fast, high-quality, no signup required.
- [Free SVG for Cricut, Silhouette, and laser cutting](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/svg-cricut/): Convert a PNG or JPG into a free SVG for Cricut, Silhouette Cameo, or laser cutting. Crisp paths, no signup, ready to cut.
- [SVG vs PNG/JPG: Core Web Vitals and SEO](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/svg-vs-png/): Replace PNG/JPG logos and icons with SVG: smaller files, Retina and 4K crispness, better LCP and CLS. A guide for developers and SEO experts.
- [Vectorize a blurry logo to SVG for free](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/vectorize-logo/): Blurry JPG or PNG logo on a poster or website? Vectorize it to a crisp SVG with PixelToPath: free, no Illustrator, in under a minute.
- [Import an SVG into Figma, Canva, WordPress](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/import-svg/): Your PixelToPath SVG is ready. Import it into Figma to change colors, into Canva, or onto WordPress without security flaws. A guide for designers.
- [How to Batch Convert PNG to SVG (5 Methods Compared)](https://pixel-to-path.com/blog/batch-convert-png-to-svg/): How to batch convert PNG to SVG: 5 tested methods compared - online tools, Pro hot folder, Inkscape, CLI scripts and the API. For 10 files or 10,000.
